title: Electrician — Power Distribution
summary: Train to install, test and maintain electrical distribution equipment.
overview: This practical trade covers electrical circuits, motors, cables and distribution systems. The DGT curriculum includes safety procedures and supervised technical practice.
path: Check the current trade entry requirements and recognised ITIs with your state admission authority.
Complete recognised Craftsmen Training Scheme training and assessment.
Explore technician work or apprenticeship opportunities; follow employer and local licensing requirements.

title: Fitter — Mechanical Trade
summary: Develop practical skills for fitting and maintaining mechanical assemblies.
overview: Fitter is a Craftsmen Training Scheme trade in manufacturing. It offers a practical training route for students interested in workshop tasks and mechanical equipment.
path: Check DGT eligibility and state ITI admission requirements; Science and Mathematics or an accepted vocational equivalent are listed by DGT.
Apply to a recognised ITI offering the Fitter trade.
Complete training and assessment, then explore workshop work or apprenticeship options.

title: Computer Operator & Programming Assistant
summary: Build practical computer, office software and introductory programming skills.
overview: COPA is a vocational training option under the Craftsmen Training Scheme. It introduces computer applications and programming, providing a starting point for further skill development.
path: Check current COPA eligibility and admission requirements with your state ITI authority.
Choose a recognised institute offering COPA and complete the required training and assessment.
Develop a small portfolio of computer tasks and explore further training or relevant entry-level opportunities.
